newsitem.title: INDIA: Landmine blast kills one, wounds two in Kashmir.
newsitem.headline: Landmine blast kills one, wounds two in Kashmir.

text.p: A landmine detonated by separatist guerrillas killed one person and wounded two paramilitary police in Kashmir on Wednesday, Indian police said.
They said separatists exploded the mine as a vehicle of the Indian Tibetan Border Police (ITBP) passed by near Nowgam on the outskirts of the summer capital of Jammu and Kashmir state, Srinagar.
A police spokesman said one civilian was killed and two ITBP policemen, including a deputy inspector general, were wounded. The vehicle was destroyed.
More than a dozen separatist groups are fighting either for the independence of Kashmir or its merger with neighbouring Pakistan. Jammu and Kashmir is mainly Hindu India's only Moslem majority state.

More than 20,000 people have been killed since 1990 when a revolt broke out in Jammu and Kashmir. India accuses Pakistan of training and arming Kashmir's Moslem militants, a charge denied by Islamabad.
